name: Lithium
note: Lithium Triangle (ARG, BOL, CHL); Brazil hard-rock (Minas Gerais); Peru (Falchani) exploration.
uses: Rechargeable lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and grid storage are the dominant use; ceramics and glass, lubricating greases and pharmaceuticals are the older ones.
why_it_matters: The battery supply chain runs through lithium carbonate and hydroxide, and the brine deposits of the Lithium Triangle (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile) hold the largest share of known resources; refining capacity is concentrated in China, so who buys the carbonate shapes who makes the batteries.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
